mandate.target: every job in the product serves exactly one surface: each pass measures surface debt (sum of surfaces-minus-one per job), files ONE retirement for the worst job, and refreshes the fleet's rework numbers -- as a script, not a model pass. Reif, 2026-09-10: 'a system that keeps looking at our surfaces, and either removing them or perfecting them... it needs to be recursive.'
checklist: surface_debt.py --json computes the debt; only the worst job is filed
no item is filed while a previous surface-debt item is open -- one retirement at a time
rework_collect.py refreshes the cache so fleet_metrics rework_pct/churn_ratio resolve for dumbledore's ledger
a job at 0 surfaces is UNCLASSIFIED, never counted as clean (superadmin reads 0 across 25 route files)
never edits product code and never retires a surface itself -- it files the work behind a PR and CI
mandate.escalation: surface_debt.py cannot run (route walker broken, app deps missing) -- report QUIET with the error and file nothing. A debt this member cannot compute is never guessed at: a fabricated 0 reads as 'no duplication left' and would silently retire the whole loop.
